description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the loan write-off and advanced payment allocation features within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup code, multiple test cases for loan write-off, reversal, and validation scenarios, as well as helper methods for creating loans and verifying transactions.

classes.name: LoanWriteOffWithAdvancedPaymentAllocationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing loan write-off and advanced payment allocation functionalities in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setupTests
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, sets up request and response specifications, and prepares helper instances before all tests.

methods.name: loanWriteOffWithAdvancedPaymentAllocationTest
methods.description: Performs a full workflow to create a loan with advanced payment allocation, apply charges, make repayment, and write off the loan, then verifies the transaction.

methods.name: loanUndoRepaymentAfterWriteOffShouldGiveErrorTest
methods.description: Tests that attempting to undo a repayment after the loan has been written off results in an error indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: loanBackdatedRepaymentAfterWriteOffShouldGiveErrorTest
methods.description: Ensures that backdated repayment after a loan has been written off results in an error, enforcing active or overpaid status.

methods.name: loanUndoWriteOffShouldGiveErrorTest
methods.description: Verifies that reversing a write-off transaction on a loan results in an error, preventing modification after write-off.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specified advanced payment allocation data and returns the product's ID.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Constructs an AdvancedPaymentData object with default allocation rules and payment order based on the provided future installment rule.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Generates a list of PaymentAllocationOrder objects in sequence for the specified payment allocation types.

methods.name: createLoanAccountAndDisbursePrincipalAmount
methods.description: Creates a loan application, approves it, and disburses the principal, returning the loan ID.

methods.name: verifyTransaction
methods.description: Checks that a transaction of a specified date and amount exists in the loan's transaction history, including verifying individual portions.
